items.title: Glover Compton Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: we went to, caught my boat, Unamay Carlisle... Unamay Carlisle was left... I told her, gee, you're popular.

ctx.x: The American Council. Said for every American throughout Europe, the different councils of the different countries, and they told you what port and the date to be there to catch your boat back to America. And we went to, caught my boat, Unamay Carlisle. She's a great pianist. Oh, yeah. American. And we went to, had to go to Ireland to pick up some Americans. Some Americans were assigned to the same boat that we were assigned to in France. They went to Cove, every other town.
